provider: Cloud to Street / Tellman et al. (2021) Nature

auth_methods: GCP Cloud Project with Earth Engine API enabled
access_requirement.credentials_status: No GEE GCP project registered in current environment. Direct binary export requires GEE authentication token.

temporal_resolution: Event-based (aggregated multi-day flood inundation extent and duration per event)

bands.name: flooded
bands.description: Binary mask indicating inundated land during the event

bands.name: duration
bands.description: Number of days the pixel remained inundated

bands.name: clear_views
bands.description: Number of cloud-free MODIS observations over the event window

bands.name: clear_perc
bands.description: Percentage of observation period with cloud-free views

bands.name: jrc_perm_water
bands.description: Permanent water mask from JRC Global Surface Water

citation: Tellman, B., Sullivan, J.A., Kuhn, C. et al. Satellite imaging reveals increased proportion of population exposed to floods. Nature 596, 80–86 (2021). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03695-w
